title: Tenant-scoped ingestion and provenance
content: NeuroFlow stores the authenticated client identifier in ingestion document metadata. Duplicate document detection is scoped by both content hash and client identifier. The ingestion status repository query filters by document UUID and metadata client_id, returning the same not-found response for missing documents and documents owned by another client. Retrieval results carry chunk IDs and metadata, while context assembly keeps source and page provenance for citations. Evaluation annotations should record the exact chunk UUIDs returned by the target ingestion run, not document UUIDs or locally invented identifiers.
